property.name: enemy
property.value: Tutorial Raider

property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text":"The raider grins. \"Ante up. We each stake a card from our decks. Win, and you keep mine. Lose, and yours is mine.\" Lands make mana, spells cost mana, you draw a card at the start of each of your turns, and you may play one land per turn. Watch the card you're staking.","options":[{"name":"(Duel)","action":[{"battleWithActorID":-1}]}]}]

property.name: defeatDialog
property.value: [{"action":[{"deleteMapObject":-1},{"activateMapObject":21}],"text":"The raider flees toward the wall. Whatever it took from you comes back in the next lesson."}]

property.name: enemy
property.value: Raider Scout

property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text":"The scout hands you a card back, but it isn't yours to keep yet. \"Here. Keep your little stone.\" Combat: on your turn, creatures you control that have been under your control since the turn began can attack. The defending player chooses which of their creatures block. Unblocked attackers deal their power to the player's life total.","options":[{"name":"(Take the card and duel)","text":"Your stolen card is returned.","action":[{"returnStolenFrom":"Tutorial Raider"}],"options":[{"name":"(Duel)","action":[{"battleWithActorID":-1}]}]}]}]

property.name: defeatDialog
property.value: [{"action":[{"deleteMapObject":-1},{"activateMapObject":22}],"text":"The scout runs off into the trees. Next lesson: your commander."}]

property.name: enemy
property.value: Raider Brute

property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text":"The brute slams a fist on the bench. \"Your commander isn't in your library. It starts in the command zone, and you can cast it from there whenever you have the mana.\" Each time you cast it from the command zone, it costs 2 more than last time. If it would die or be exiled, you may put it back in the command zone instead.","options":[{"name":"(Duel)","action":[{"battleWithActorID":-1}]}]}]

property.name: defeatDialog
property.value: [{"action":[{"deleteMapObject":-1},{"activateMapObject":23}],"text":"The brute grumbles and leaves. One more lesson, then the rival."}]
